panel: All E/I/N siblings of the six task groups in the frozen eight-privacy-loss archive; seed44 raw predictions.
decision_backend: Identical symbolic planner for all reviewed contracts; unusable contracts fail closed.
scope: Historical-error diagnostic on exposed tasks, not independent method confirmation.
hypothesis: Full semantic binding review can correct valid-but-wrong companion roles that invalid-field-only repair must retain.
alternative: Full review introduces unsupported constraints or rewrites correct privacy; a fresh compile may be sufficient.
budget_rule: Stop at wall-time budget, retain incomplete calls and rotate arm order. Only complete three-arm rows enter paired descriptive tables; report all model costs.
claim_rule: No tuning based on these historical outcomes; independent requests and task groups are required before a method claim. No significance from this selected small cohort.
